description: Add a speaking-avatar intro using the browser Web Speech API (window.speechSynthesis). Create a reusable useSpeech hook in the existing hooks barrel and wire a visible control button plus a one-time first-gesture trigger into the Hero section, speaking profile.voiceIntro. Depends on FEAT-002 (reads profile.voiceIntro) and benefits from FEAT-001's palette (button uses blue accent). No new npm dependency.
steps: src/hooks/index.js: add `export function useSpeech()`. It returns { speak, stop, speaking, supported }. `supported` = typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window. Maintain a `speaking` state via useState. Resolve an English voice: read window.speechSynthesis.getVoices(), prefer a voice whose lang starts with 'en-US' then 'en-GB' then any 'en'; because voices can load async, also subscribe to the 'voiceschanged' event to refresh the chosen voice, and clean up the listener on unmount. speak(text): if not supported or no text, return; call window.speechSynthesis.cancel() first to stop anything ongoing; build a SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text), set utterance.lang='en-US', rate=0.95, pitch=1.0, assign the chosen English voice if found; set onstart -> setSpeaking(true), onend and onerror -> setSpeaking(false); call window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance). stop(): if supported, window.speechSynthesis.cancel() and setSpeaking(false). Guard all window access so it is SSR/undefined-safe, matching the existing useReducedMotion/useIsMobile patterns in this file. Also cancel speech on unmount.

src/components/sections/Hero.section.jsx: import { profile }, useSpeech, and useReducedMotion. Call const { speak, stop, speaking, supported } = useSpeech(). Add a handler toggleIntro = () => speaking ? stop() : speak(profile.voiceIntro). In a useEffect, if supported, attach ONE-TIME document listeners for 'click' and 'keydown' that call speak(profile.voiceIntro) the first time and then remove BOTH listeners (use a ref/flag so it fires once); clean up on unmount. (Do not auto-speak on mount alone — browser autoplay policy blocks it.)

src/components/sections/Hero.section.jsx: in the right column, near/under the 3D avatar panel, render the control only when `supported`: a Button (import exists) wrapped as the others are, with onClick={toggleIntro}, aria-label={speaking ? 'Stop introduction audio' : 'Play audio introduction'}, label text `speaking ? '⏸ Stop' : '▶ Hear intro'`, styled with the existing Button component (variant 'outline' or 'secondary') so it inherits the new blue accent. When speaking, also show a small 'Speaking…' chip with a pulsing accent dot (reuse the existing `animate-ping`/`bg-accent` pattern already used for the status chip); skip the pulse animation when useReducedMotion() is true. Keep layout consistent with the existing Reveal/MagneticButton usage.
Ensure graceful degradation: when supported is false the button and chip are not rendered and nothing throws; speech is spoken once per trigger (never looped).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` completes successfully and `npm run lint` passes.
useSpeech is exported from src/hooks/index.js and returns speak, stop, speaking, supported.
Hero renders a control button with an aria-label near the avatar when speechSynthesis is supported, toggling label between '▶ Hear intro' and '⏸ Stop'.

In a browser dev run, clicking the button speaks profile.voiceIntro once; the first click/keydown anywhere also triggers it once and the listener does not re-fire; no console errors; nothing breaks when speechSynthesis is unavailable.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it exits 0.
Run `npm run lint` and confirm no new errors.

Run `npm run dev`, open Home, confirm the 'Hear intro' button appears near the avatar, click it and confirm speech starts and the label toggles to '⏸ Stop', and confirm the one-time first-gesture trigger fires once with no console errors.
findings: FEAT-002 dependency satisfied: profile.voiceIntro already present in src/data/profile.js (no script needed). Added useSpeech() to src/hooks/index.js returning { speak, stop, speaking, supported }: resolves an English voice (en-US > en-GB > any en), subscribes to 'voiceschanged', cancels before speaking so audio never overlaps/loops, cancels on unmount, and guards all window access (SSR-safe like the sibling hooks). Wired Hero.section.jsx: useSpeech + useReducedMotion, toggleIntro handler, and a one-time document click/keydown first-gesture trigger (ref-guarded, removes both listeners after firing, cleans up on unmount). Control button rendered only when supported (variant 'outline', size 'sm') with aria-label ('Play audio introduction' / 'Stop introduction audio') toggling '▶ Hear intro' <-> '⏸ Stop'; a 'Speaking…' chip with an accent ping dot shows while speaking (ping skipped under reduced motion). Used lucide Volume2/Square icons to match existing icon pattern. Verification: `npm run build` exits 0 (2568 modules transformed); `npm run lint` 0 errors (5 pre-existing warnings in unrelated files, none introduced by this change). Interactive `npm run dev` browser verification (live speech playback + gesture trigger) could not be run here — the execution harness blocks long-running dev-server commands; the production build is the authoritative gate per context.json and validates imports/JSX/refs. Recommend a manual `npm run dev` smoke test to hear the intro.
